Deutscher Jugendliteraturpreis.fact: The Deutscher Jugendliteraturpreis (German Children’s Literature Award ) is an annual award set up in 1956 by the Federal Ministry for Education, Family Affairs, Senior Citizens, Women and Youth to recognise outstanding works of children's and young adult literature. It is Germany's only state-funded literary award.
